name: The Bay Terrace Shopping Center
summary: The Bay Terrace Shopping Center is an enduring open-air retail destination in Bayside, Queens, featuring popular retailers, diverse dining options, and free parking. Located at the corner of 26th Avenue and Bell Boulevard, this community-focused center serves as a convenient gathering place for shopping, dining, and services.
demographics: The Bay Terrace Shopping Center serves the affluent Bayside community in northeastern Queens, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle-class families and professionals with household incomes above the New York City median. The trade area draws heavily from nearby residential neighborhoods including Bayside, Douglaston, and Little Neck, with shoppers typically ranging from young families to established empty-nesters aged 30-65. The center's visitor base reflects the area's diverse, educated population with strong purchasing power, seeking convenient access to quality retailers and dining options. Shopping patterns emphasize regular weekly visits for groceries and services, complemented by leisure dining and retail browsing on weekends.
description: The Bay Terrace Shopping Center stands as a cornerstone of the Bayside community, offering an enduring open-air shopping experience at the prominent corner of 26th Avenue and Bell Boulevard in Queens, New York. This well-established retail destination has served northeastern Queens residents for decades, evolving to meet the changing needs of its affluent and diverse customer base. The center features a carefully curated mix of popular national retailers, diverse dining establishments, and essential services, all set within a convenient open-air layout that provides easy access and complimentary parking for shoppers. Managed by CORD MEYER Development LLC, Bay Terrace has maintained its reputation as a place to find, dine, and unwind, creating a welcoming environment where the community gathers for both everyday needs and special occasions. With its strategic location in one of Queens' most desirable neighborhoods and its commitment to providing quality shopping and dining experiences, The Bay Terrace Shopping Center continues to be a vital retail hub that enhances the lifestyle of Bayside residents and visitors from surrounding areas.
